title: Northgate Cash Category Bonus on Everyday Purchases
content:
Grocery, household essentials, beauty and apparel lines carry extra Northgate Cash under the consumer earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships: the merchandise category of the line the schedule settles adds percentage points to its earning percentage. The category is the one recorded on the line on Northgate Store and Online Orders.

| Merchandise category of the line | Points added |
|---|---|
| grocery | 0.5 |
| household essentials | 0.5 |
| beauty | 0.25 |
| apparel | 0.25 |
| any other category | none |

**Hypothetical illustrations**

- A line of household essentials carries 0.5 added percentage points.
- A line of apparel carries 0.25 added percentage points.
- A line of small appliances carries no added points from this bonus.
